howToPlay: Use Belle's long range to poke enemies from a distance. Use her Super to mark key targets to increase damage taken, and place her Nest Egg trap to control area and slow down enemies.
gears: Recommended gears include DAMAGE for increased output when low on health, RELOAD SPEED for better sustained fire, and SHIELD for extra survivability.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer long-range precision and strategic utility support.
